description.value: Otter Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative serving communities across the Lower Mainland, Fraser Valley, and Okanagan, offering food, fuel, pharmacy, feed, and liquor under one roof. As a member-owned organization, it is part of a long-standing BC co-operative tradition. The breadth of services makes it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the Langley/Aldergrove area.
